title: Chinese fugitive’s overstay prompts PNP foreigner crackdown

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police is stepping up intelligence and monitoring operations against foreign nationals wanted for criminal offenses overseas following the arrest of a Chinese fugitive who had been staying in the Philippines for 12 years. “Foreign fugitives must not mistake our hospitality for a license to evade justice,” said PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. in a statement on Monday. “We will strengthen our intelligence and law enforcement efforts to ensure that no individual, regardless of nationality or length of stay, can use Philippine territory as a refuge from the law,” added Nartatez.
